name: Cutpurse
summary: A practiced street thief who sizes up marks and steals during a sudden attack.

features.name: Measure the Mark
features.summary: Learn a target's Perception result before deciding whether to attempt Sleight of Hand, and Bluff away an aborted attempt.

features.name: Stab and Grab
features.summary: As a full-round action, attack and steal from the target; sneak attack enables this during normal combat and imposes –5 Perception.
